newsitem.title: USA: Zitel to post charge for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Zitel to post charge for acquisitions.

text.p: Zitel Corp said Wednesday it has entered into an agreement in principle to acquire three privately-held companies for about $12.5 million in cash and stock.
Zitel said it expects to post a charge, close to the purchase price, in the third quarter related to the acquisition.

The company plans to acquire Datametrics Systems Corp, a performance capacity management software company based in Fairfax, Va.; Palmer & Webb Systems Ltd, a U.K.-based company focused on the development and distribution of data management tools; Palmer & Webb Systems BV, a Dutch-based company focused on the sale of automation products, capacity management products and related services.
The company said it expects to post a one-time, non-recurring charge of a substantial portion of the purchase price for the write-off of acquired in-process research and development.
The transactions are expected to close in mid-June.
